notes.title: Demo update v0.02.018
notes.notes:
Hi All!



Updated the visuals again, now I am actually quite happy with it. You can now make the game super intense like in the trailer, or make it easy on the eyes. There are some presets, but also sliders with direct visual feedback. 



Updated in this version:

Visual overhaul (again) but now I am finally satisfied

Redesigned the visual settings menu

Added pulsing hurt animation on low health

Redesigned shop little bit

Fixed crash when leaving level while punching

Fixed bug in nail to wall (or actually re-implemented a past bug that became a feature, but broke with some previous update)

Fixed de-saturation on dead

Removed enemy shadows

Reduced enemy damage in later levels a bit

Improved homing on melee attacks

Reduced player damage when nailed to wall by enemy

Added hurt graphic to dead screen

notes.title: Demo update v0.02.015
notes.notes:
Hi All!



You can now add Boss enemies to the Boss levels by activating the "more boss" difficulty modifier at the start of your run! Let me know if you can beat him!



Check out this short to get a sneak peak how it was designed:

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VZKIOhkapQE"][/dynamiclink]



Updated in this version:

added difficulty option to add boss enemies to the boss levels,

Fixed riot shield reflecting bullets with trigger

Removed Glass Canon (will probably come back later)

Made rerolls cheaper but double every reroll

Added text to double mod cross in inventory, to make it more clear what is going on

Updated how cards combine, you can now reduce insane scaling from combining God cards by combining with a normal card

tweaked visual pre-set settings

Fixed bug not saving HP player correctly

Added base HP player to inventory

Fixed sound homing playing to much

Fixed typo in menu

notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!


Demo Releases
Good news, the Flashes of Chaos Demo will release August 8, 2025.


Playtest End
Thank you all for playing the Flashes of Chaos Playtest! Your feedback has been very valuable to improve the Flashes of Chaos Demo experience! As the Demo will release August 8, the playtest will also close on August 8. In the future there will likely be a new playtest for the full game. If you want to get updated on this you can join the mailing list at brainburnstudio.com. 


Update Overview From Playtest
Overview of the main updates as the result of the playtest are in no particular order:

Replaced boring modifiers with not boring modifiers. All modifiers now synergizes at least with one other modifier

Added a story to the game/demo

Added a increased difficulty option to the demo

Custom crosshairs per gun

Many UI improvements

Many tutorial improvements

Fixed some fatal crashes

Added a lot of settings to adjust the visuals of the game

Better visuals for explosions and Melee attacks.


Store Page Overhaul
To celebrate the upcoming release of the Demo, the story page has gotten a complete overhaul, with new screenshots and soon a updated trailer for the Demo release.
